verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a tax agency with filing and payment systems, since agencies can offer developer test environments, so the axis applies. The evidence only records Akamai 403 denials at robots.txt and the MyFTB/Web Pay host, with nothing documenting a sandbox, test environment or non-production endpoint. The probes show those hosts deny keyless agents; they do not show whether a sandbox exists.
